# ibee_gpu_vm (Resource)

A gpu VM priced from the public compute catalog. Configuration changes replace the VM. Imports use the VM ID. Public-IP release is explicit; no payment is initiated by Terraform.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cpu` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `delete_public_ip_action` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | release (default) or reserve the automatic public IP on destroy. Reserving an address may continue billing. |
| `disk_gb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `gpu_count` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `gpu_model` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `name` | `string` | Required | VM name. |
| `os_distro` | `string` | Required | Image OS distribution. |
| `os_type` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `plan_id` | `string` | Required | Selectable, priced plan from ibee_compute_plans. |
| `private_ip` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `public_ip` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `ram_mb` | `number` | Read-only |  |
| `site_id` | `string` | Required | Placement site from ibee_sites. |
| `ssh_key_ids` | `set(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | Existing Secret Store SSH key IDs. Changes replace the VM. |
| `status` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `tags` | `set(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | VM tags. Changes replace the VM because the public API has no tag update operation. |
| `template_id` | `string` | Required | Image template from ibee_images. |

## Import

This resource supports import. Use the public resource ID unless its description specifies a composite identifier or bucket name. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.

```sh
terraform import ibee_gpu_vm.example 'RESOURCE_ID'
```
